title: Hruday window-kernel certificate for the centered Wilson correlation at the original cap
accepted: In the AM2/AQ1 zero-selected patterned family (SU(2) Kogut-Susskind form on Z^3 at fixed spacing, coarse 24-link factors, selected triple exactly (0,0,0) with Haar product reference, whole stars phi_b=-(tau/3) sum W_f; original xz Wilson loop W with complete cover R={0,e_z} and seven incident stars; physical clock s=alpha*t_E/hbar, theta=alpha*t/hbar, G=H/alpha), at the original cap tau=+10^-8 and, as a replay of the same |tau| formula at the mirrored coupling, tau=-10^-8, every AQ1 subsequential state of the centered whole-star construction (each chosen state separately; no uniqueness, whole-sequence convergence or rate in N) has centered Euclidean Wilson correlation C(s)=<chi,e^{-sG}chi>, chi=(pi(W)-omega(W))Omega, satisfying at the single preregistered node s=1: |C(1)-d|<=r with the exact rational datum d=497870683678639429793424156500617766317/(4*10^40) (~0.012446767091965986, the midpoint of the directed enclosure of e^{-3}/4) and r<=R=1831967503411879425147166810021607/10^40 (~1.83196750341e-7, a directed upper bound of both producers' exact radii, which differ by 2.52e-41 and exceed the analytic bound by less than 10^-40), so C(1) in [497863355808625782275723567833377679889/(4*10^40), 99575602309730615462224949033571570549/(8*10^39)] ~ [0.0124465838952156, 0.0124469502887164], meeting the unchanged 10^-6 target (margin 5.4586). The bound is E=M_0(D+D^2)+k M_1=2(D+D^2)+49|tau|s/pi plus the arithmetic half-width 1/(4*10^40): the frozen C^2 window g(x)=e^{-sx} (x>=0), e^{sx}(1-2sx+2s^2x^2) (x<0) has ghat=4s^3/(pi(s-i theta)^3(s+i theta)) in L^1 with M_0=||ghat||_1=2, M_1=4s/pi, M_2=2s^2, proved by half-line transforms (forward) and by residues (reverse); the window lemma C(s)=int ghat c uses L^1 inversion, Fubini and AQ1 nonnegativity only (no AQ2 gap); the seven-star relative-unitary Duhamel slope k=49|tau|/4 holds for every real theta uniformly in the box; the state term uses the AV1-admitted forward tier-(ii) bound D=585079838465912592144137406066050/42981220507576537932303142777593983768257 (~1.3612e-8) by trace duality with no D/2 effect refinement, and m^2<=D^2 is charged. The free reference e^{-3}/4 lies inside the interval (reference_unresolved): no interaction shift, sign or coefficient of C(s) is claimed. Retained failures at unchanged tau and s: the AT4 Poisson certificate at L=10^4 (radius ~8.4152e-4) and the Poisson floor, at least 1.2650882233e-6 for every cutoff L even with D->0 (at least 1.2787e-6 with the admitted D), whose truncated absolute first moment (s/pi)log(1+L^2/s^2) diverges against the window's finite 4s/pi, both insufficient; the tier-(i) window radius ~4.7518e-5 is a retained limited-tier value and the C^1 window (radius ~1.7330e-7) is a preview only. The analytic formula crosses 10^-6 at s* in [6.236863446, 6.236863447] (~6.2368634460); only s=1 is certified. No grid or [0,128] claim, resolved interaction shift, uniform Wilson, weak-coupling, continuum, uniqueness or rate claim follows.
limitations: Only the AM2/AQ1 zero-selected patterned family, the cover R={0,e_z}, fixed spacing and the single node s=1 at tau=+-10^-8; nothing transfers to nonzero selected triples (non-Haar P_R), uniform Wilson theory, weak coupling or the continuum
